title: Centre for Advanced Manufacturing and Supply Chains - Home
gist: Landing page of the WEF Centre for Advanced Manufacturing and Supply Chains highlighting the 238-factory Global Lighthouse Network and the AI-enabled Lumina platform; promotional.

insights.claim: The Global Lighthouse Network now engages 238 factories deploying Fourth Industrial Revolution technologies, backed by 217 business partners and 11 initiatives.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum

insights.claim: Lumina is an AI-enabled intelligence platform built on eight years of Global Lighthouse Network evidence to provide decision intelligence for industrial transformation.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: Shows WEF productising its manufacturing evidence base with AI.
